title: Anatomy of an Echo
description: The reason to read is the human distance between resembling and continuing.

readerInvitation.reasonToExist: Anatomy of an Echo brings digital immortality into an intimate household. A promised continuation can preserve a likeness while unsettling a relationship. This science fiction novel begins with a potter and an imperfect bowl.
readerInvitation.readerPromise: The reason to read is the human distance between resembling and continuing.
readerInvitation.audienceFit: The story suits readers drawn to intimate science fiction and difficult institutions.
readerInvitation.closingInvitation: Begin with The Bowl That Listened and its slightly uneven rim.
readerOutcomes: Read how the scene lets judgment emerge from making and handling things.
The story keeps their disagreements alive instead of resolving them through terminology.
Notice who can interrupt whom when the conversation becomes inconvenient.
Reading gives these competing claims time to become more than positions.
This introduction leaves their sequence and eventual outcomes for you to encounter.
